name: eutrya
description: Eutrya native swarm harness with an integrated desktop interface

scripts.check: npm --prefix runtime run check && node --check desktop/web/backend.js && node --check desktop/web/core.js && node --check desktop/web/app.js && node --check runtime/desktop/server.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm --prefix runtime install && cd desktop && cargo tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm --prefix runtime install && cd desktop && cargo tauri build
